sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State air quality monitoring programme, disseminated through U.S. EPA AirNow
The Urban Unit (sensor owner) with AirGradient (instrument provider)

cross_source_agreement.detail: 1399 days with both sources; Pearson r = 0.87, mean PAQI − Consulate = 3.43 µg/m³, 63 days flagged for large disagreement.

two_independent_publishers.detail: PAQI (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0) and the U.S. Department of State monitor (AirNow via OpenAQ, US Public Domain) are different original publishers. PAQI does not document its input monitors, so measurement-level independence is reported as agreement statistics rather than assumed.

cross_source.large_disagreement_rule: difference outside [Q1 - 3·IQR, Q3 + 3·IQR] of paired daily differences; flagged, not removed
cross_source.date_alignment_caveat: PAQI does not publish its day boundary/timezone; Consulate days are Asia/Karachi local days.
